lead: An integer literal in a `??` fallback keeps its own `int`, so a `uint` binding refuses the whole expression.
body: `uint $page = ($q["page"] as ?uint) ?? 1;` is `E0401: expected `uint`, found `uint|int``, because the literal takes no hint from the `as ?uint` beside it. Declare the fallback as a binding of the target type — `uint $firstPage = 1;` — rather than writing `?? (1 as uint)`, which reads as a conversion nobody asked for.
